scope: Full positive-radicand criterion for real symmetric 3×3 matrices: exact Cholesky radicands equal the rational LDL pivots, positive pivots yield an exact sum-of-squares decomposition and Matrix.PosDef. Proves the square-root enclosure rule, the literal interval-radicand statement, and an executable dyadic rational checker whose accepted input box certifies every represented matrix. Kernel-checked examples accept the identity and reject a zero pivot and an indefinite matrix.
